systems.name: 2.1 In-Game Editor Core
systems.notes: Build a visual map editor integrated with the engine. Must support sector painting, room placement, height editing, texture assignment, and enemy placement.
tasks: Create editor mode toggle (link in mod editor menu)

systems.name: 2.2 Entity & Thing Placement
systems.notes: Place enemies, pickups, torches, secret walls, and triggers via drag-and-drop or click.

systems.name: 2.3 BSP & Sector Tools
systems.notes: Edit BSP tree structure: merge/split sectors, define corridors, set light levels per sector.
tasks: Sector property editor (light level, ceiling height)

systems.name: 2.4 Export/Import & File Management
systems.notes: Save edited maps to a file format that can be loaded by the game. Support multiple maps.
